note: Due dates for filing 2026 returns and paying 2027 estimated taxes. Dates already moved off weekends and federal holidays. Disaster extensions are not included.

items.title: 4th-quarter 2026 estimated tax payment
items.description: Last estimated payment for 2026 income not covered by withholding (federal Form 1040-ES; Ohio IT 1040ES; local estimates for RITA or CCA if you make them).

items.title: W-2s and 1099-NECs due
items.description: Employers give employees their W-2s and file them with the government. Businesses send and file Form 1099-NEC for contractors. (January 31 falls on a Sunday.)

items.title: 4th-quarter payroll return (Form 941) and annual FUTA return (Form 940)
items.description: Employers file the 4th-quarter 2026 Form 941 and the 2026 Form 940.

items.title: Partnership and S corporation returns
items.description: Calendar-year partnerships (Form 1065) and S corporations (Form 1120-S) file 2026 returns or request an extension.

items.title: 2026 individual tax returns and payments
items.description: Federal Form 1040, Ohio IT 1040 and local (RITA or CCA) returns for 2026 are due, along with any balance owed. Last day to request a filing extension (an extension does not extend the time to pay).

items.title: 1st-quarter 2027 estimated tax payment
items.description: First estimated payment for 2027 income not covered by withholding.

items.title: Last day for 2026 IRA and HSA contributions
items.description: Contributions to a traditional or Roth IRA or an HSA for 2026 must be made by this date.

items.title: 1st-quarter payroll return (Form 941)
items.description: Employers file Form 941 for January through March 2027.

items.title: 2nd-quarter payroll return (Form 941)
items.description: Employers file Form 941 for April through June 2027. (July 31 falls on a Saturday.)

items.title: 3rd-quarter 2027 estimated tax payment; extended partnership and S corporation returns
items.description: Third estimated payment for 2027. Partnerships and S corporations that got an extension file their 2026 returns.

items.title: Extended 2026 individual returns
items.description: If you got an extension, your 2026 return is due.

items.title: 3rd-quarter payroll return (Form 941)
items.description: Employers file Form 941 for July through September 2027. (October 31 falls on a Sunday.)

items.title: 4th-quarter 2027 estimated tax payment
items.description: Last estimated payment for 2027. (January 15 falls on a Saturday and January 17 is Martin Luther King Jr. Day.)
